outcome: Professors can now generalize an existing unavailable candidate when later scientific evidence shows it is too narrow
owner_impact: A candidate flagged by later overlapping science can now be broadened or refined directly in the Professor inbox without creating a second request. The stable request/candidate identity and all linked evidence remain attached, every Professor revision is audited, and fresh research-AI sessions immediately see the revised candidate. Generalization does not implement the capability and does not soften the authoring/compiler wall.

next.text: Next is #371, the fresh two-paper black-box acceptance. It will test from clean chats that supported science authors normally, unsupported science stays blocked, overlapping papers reuse/generalize one candidate, and genuinely absent needs create only the necessary new candidates. It has not started yet.
